olivia_sales: Quick sync: enterprise pilot (payments). Requirements: streaming generation + function calls that emit newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) with a strict schema version tag. They need SSO (pref OIDC), customer-managed KMS, and procurement wants a one-month pilot price. Can eng/sec/ops confirm feasibility and a short checklist?

cadence_eng: A few clarifiers: 1) will function outputs be used inline for decisioning or primarily batched? 2) do they require server-side schema enforcement or just stamped version tags? 3) target p99 latency and peak qps?

olivia_sales: Inline for decisioning is critical, occasional batch jobs ok. Server-side stamping of schema_version required so downstream consumers can rely on it. Target 70 qps peak, p99 < 350ms.

cadence_eng: Implementation pattern we recommend: SSE streaming with explicit event entries per line of NDJSON. Each function_call event includes "schema_version":"v1" and a compact arguments object. Use session pinning to enforce ordering across a conversation. Example parsing pattern (Python streaming):```python
for line in sse_stream:
    entry = json.loads(line)
    if entry["type"] == "function_call":
        schema = entry["schema_version"]
        args = entry["arguments"]
        validate(args, schema)  # client-side validation
```This minimizes latency and keeps records machine-friendly.

yusuf_security: Security summary: OIDC and SAML supported. For CMK we support AWS KMS and GCP KMS on Dedicated/Private; hosted CMK possible with enterprise contract. Recommend short-lived API tokens + SCIM provisioning for user sync. For webhook callbacks require mTLS + cert rotation. On-prem HSM elevates to enterprise track and increases lead time.

margo_ops: Ops notes: to guarantee ordering pick Dedicated with session affinity; hosted can approximate ordering but may reorder under burst. Enable token-level cost visibility and export traces to their SIEM. For NDJSON ingestion surface, advise backpressure and reconnect jitter handling. We'll kick a dedicated pool sizing job after commitment.

olivia_sales: Procurement wants a pilot price: 1 month, 70 qps, approx 220k tokens/day streaming + function calls. Any quick hosted vs dedicated numbers I can quote?

cadence_eng: Rough hosted example: streaming gen ~ $0.00078/token (model-dependent). 220k/day * 30 = 6.6M tokens -> ~$5.15k/month. If they require ordering with SLA pick Dedicated: expect an initial reserved commit in the ~$18k-28k/month band depending on region and instance types. We can propose a hybrid path (hosted dev + dedicated pilot). I'll run a model-mix sim if you need tightened numbers.

yusuf_security: Security review ETA: SAQ + OIDC + KMS config ~2 weeks. Add 1-2 weeks for SCIM testing and mTLS webhook verification. On-prem HSM adds multi-week lead time.

margo_ops: I'll prepare SIEM export docs and a short NDJSON backpressure runbook. We'll also prepare a quantized fallback plan (INT8) to cut cost during spikes and keep availability.

olivia_sales: Can we get a short, customer-ready checklist and a tiny sample NDJSON line (to paste into procurement docs)?

cadence_eng: Sure  compact checklist: 1) confirm model(s) + token budget 2) choose hosting mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) 3) select SSO (OIDC/SAML) + SCIM 4) select KMS (AWS/GCP/Redwood) 5) decide inline vs async flows & webhook endpoints (mTLS if used) 6) provide JSON schema(s) + versioning rules (we stamp schema_version) 7) telemetry destination & retention 8) pilot timeline & acceptance criteria

cadence_eng: Sample NDJSON line (one record per line):
{"type":"function_call","schema_version":"v1","function":"fraud_assess","arguments":{"tx_id":"tx_01b3","amount":257.00,"currency":"USD","user_id":"u_77"}}

ops-bot: [task] queued Dedicated sizing run: job-id dsz-2147.

margo_ops: I'll follow up with SIEM and reconnection patterns. cadence_eng, please run the quantized sim and include a fallback policy for 95th pct spikes.

cadence_eng: Will do  posting numbers by EOD with a quantized-4 fallback and suggested failover thresholds.

olivia_sales: Thanks everyone  I'll attach this to the SAQ reply and push for NDA to share architecture diagram for Private deployment. Appreciate the rapid turnaround! :heart:
